# Cometux maintained package set.
#
# The auto-update workflow scans exactly these recipes instead of the
# upstream @all sweep: with BUILD_PACKAGES=true every bumped package is
# rebuilt in CI for verification, so an unbounded sweep over ~26000
# recipes risks blowing the 6h job limit.
#
# Contents: everything the self-hosted repository currently ships, plus
# packages recommended by those (npm was the tell — upstream split it out
# of nodejs in v25.3.0-1, so `pkg install nodejs` no longer provides it
# and nothing pulled it into the build set).
#
# Names are recipe directory names, not binary package names — a
# subpackage (clang -> libllvm, bzip2 -> libbz2) has no recipe of its own
# and is rejected by the build workflow.
#
# To regenerate: map every Package: field in the live repository's
# Packages files back to the recipe that produces it, then union with the
# TERMUX_PKG_RECOMMENDS of those recipes.
